The APLA database codes asylum legislation in 19 Latin American countries from 1990 to 2020, using 65 indicators of policy outputs. It is introduced in [Hammoud-Gallego (2022), *International Migration Review*](papers/liberal-region-asylum.qmd) and used in [Hammoud-Gallego and Freier (2023), *American Political Science Review*](papers/symbolic-refugee-protection.qmd).

[Download the data on GitHub](https://github.com/HammoudG/APLA_Dataset)

Please cite: Hammoud-Gallego, O. (2022). A Liberal Region in a World of Closed Borders? The Liberalization of Asylum Policies in Latin America, 1990–2020. *International Migration Review*, 56(1), 63–96. <https://doi.org/10.1177/01979183211026202>
